# SRD Feature Trigger Analysis

Analysis of all feature descriptions in the `daggerheart-srd` repo to extract **trigger conditions** (the "X" in "When you X, you may [spend Y to] do Z") and to assess how accurately those triggers can be detected with regular expressions.

**Source:** All feature/ability text from ancestries, communities, classes (including hope features), subclasses (foundation, mastery, specialization), weapons, armor, adversaries, beastforms, and abilities (spells).  
**Generated by:** `node scripts/analyze-srd-triggers.js`

---

## Summary

| Metric | Value |
|--------|--------|
| Total feature/ability texts analyzed | 949 |
| Features with at least one extracted trigger | 467 |
| Features with **more than one** trigger in the same text | 101 |
| Unique trigger phrases (label + normalized text) | 476 |
| Unique values of X (one row per X in table) | 476 |

### Trigger categories (feature-occurrences)

| Category | Feature-occurrences | Distinct phrases |
|----------|---------------------|------------------|
| **when_you** | 207 | 177 |
| **when_other** | 195 | 186 |
| **while** | 101 | 88 |
| **once_per** | 80 | 3 |
| **after_you** | 15 | 11 |

- **when_you** — "When you X" (PC does something).
- **when_other** — "When a/an/the [creature/adversary/target] X" (external event).
- **while** — "While X" (ongoing state).
- **once_per** — "Once per session / rest / long rest".
- **after_you** — "After you X".
- **once_per_when** — "Once per rest, when you X" (frequency + condition).

---

## Part 0: Format "When \<actor\> \<verb\>, you may \<spend\> to \<action\>."

The script first checks each description for the **exact** pattern:

**When \<actor\> \<verb\>, you may \<spend\> to \<action\>.**

(SRD text often uses "you can" instead of "you may"; the script accepts both for the table.)

- **Set aside:** Features with **0 matches** or **2+ matches** are not in the table.
- **Table:** Features with **exactly one match** get one row each with four fields: **actor**, **verb**, **spend**, **action** (plus source/parent/name and may/can).
- **Output:** Console table (truncated) and full data in **`docs/srd-when-may-to-table.csv`** (all four fields plus source, parent, name, mayOrCan) for grouping.

### Near-misses

Features that suggest the format but don’t match exactly once are reported by reason:

- **has "When" but no "you may/can" in expected place** — e.g. "When you X, roll a d6" or "When you X, you have advantage."
- **uses "you can" instead of "you may"** — has "you can" but no " to " before the action (e.g. "you can become _Unstoppable_").
- **has "When" and "you can" (different structure)** — e.g. "you can X instead of Y" or "you can reroll it" (no " to " clause).
- **multiple matches** — text contains the pattern 2+ times (e.g. Primal Origin: Arcane Charge); listed under "Set aside: 2+ matches."

Run `node scripts/analyze-srd-triggers.js` to regenerate the Part 0 table, near-miss list, and CSV.

### Better actor/verb split (regex)

The script uses two patterns so the **actor** is not split on the first space (e.g. "an adversary" not "an" + "adversary marks..."):

1. **When (determiner + noun phrase) (verb …), you may/can … to …**  
   Actor is `(an?|the|another)` plus a noun phrase that stops **right before** a predicate verb. The verb phrase is required to start with a known predicate verb (third person / infinitive), e.g. `marks`, `makes`, `takes`, `has`, `succeeds`, `attacks`, `is`, `are`, `would`, etc. Use **full forms** (`marks`, `attacks`) not optional `s` so phrases like "an attack roll" stay one noun phrase.

   - Noun phrase: greedy `(?:(?!\s+(?:VERB_START)\b)[\s\S])+` so "an attack roll against you" is consumed before " succeeds".
   - Verb list (no optional `s`):  
     `marks|makes|takes|has|have|moves|deals|succeeds|fails|is|are|would|causes|attacks|dies|enters|forces|spots|becomes|appears|summons|combines|rolls`

   Regex (with `VERB_START` substituted):

   ```js
   When\s+((?:an?|the|another)\s+(?:(?!\s+(?:marks|makes|takes|has|have|moves|deals|succeeds|fails|is|are|would|causes|attacks|dies|enters|forces|spots|becomes|appears|summons|combines|rolls)\b)[\s\S])+)\s+((?:marks|makes|...|rolls)\b[\s\S]+?),\s*you (may|can)\s+([\s\S]*?)\s+to\s+([\s\S]+?)(?:\.|$)
   ```

2. **When you/you're (verb …), you may/can … to …**  
   Simpler pattern: actor is `you` or `you're`, verb is the rest of the when-clause:

   ```js
   When\s+(you|you're)\s+([\s\S]+?),\s*you (may|can)\s+([\s\S]*?)\s+to\s+([\s\S]+?)(?:\.|$)
   ```

Run the script first with the determiner pattern; then run the you/you're pattern; if neither matches, fall back to a single `When\s+(.+?)\s+([\s\S]+?),` style split (one space, so actor can be a single word).

## Part 1: Trigger conditions (comprehensive set)

**One row per unique value of X.** Each row is a distinct trigger condition (X); the **Prefixes** column lists all unique phrasing prefixes that appear with that X in the SRD (e.g. "When you", "Once per", "While").

### Top triggers by count (one row per unique X)

| X (trigger condition) | Prefixes | Count | Example sources |
|------------------------|----------|-------|------------------|
| long rest | Once per | 40 | classes/Guardian: Unstoppable; classes/Sorcerer: … |
| rest | Once per | 34 | ancestries/Goblin: Danger Sense; communities/Orderborne: … |
| session | Once per | 6 | ancestries/Faerie: Luckbender; communities/Wanderborne: … |
| make an attack | When you | 6 | weapons/Rapier: Quick; weapons/Improved Rapier: Quick |
| succeed on an attack against a target within... | When you | 5 | ancestries/Faun: Kick; ancestries/Orc: Tusks |
| make an attack, roll a d6 | After you | 5 | weapons/Blunderbuss: Reloading; weapons/Black Powder: … |
| move | When you | 5 | beastforms/Mighty Strider: Carrier; beastforms/… |
| flying | While | 4 | ancestries/Faerie: Wings; subclasses/Winged Sentinel: … |
| spotlighted in this way deal half damage | While | 4 | adversaries/Knight of the Realm: For the Realm!; … |
| take major or greater damage, you drop out of... | When you | 4 | beastforms/Agile Scout: Fragile; beastforms/Household Friend: Fragile |
| take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens | When you | 4 | abilities/Strategic Approach: … |
| roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll... | When you | 3 | weapons/Knuckle Blades: Brutal; weapons/Yutari Blades: … |
| elemental makes a successful attack against... | When a creature/adversary | 3 | adversaries/Minor Chaos Elemental: Momentum; … |
| ooze makes a successful attack, the target... | When a creature/adversary | 3 | adversaries/Green Ooze: Acidic Form; … |
| you're in this form | While | 3 | beastforms/Legendary Beast: Evolved; … |

Many triggers appear only once. If the same X appears under different phrasings (e.g. "When you" and "After you"), Prefixes lists all of them. Run `node scripts/analyze-srd-triggers.js` to print every unique X with its Prefixes list and count.

### Examples of distinct trigger wording

- **When you** — take minor/short rest/succeed on attack/make an attack/mark stress/roll with Fear/drop out of beastform/give a Rally Die to an ally/help an ally/encourage an ally/deal damage to an adversary/take physical damage/take severe damage, etc.
- **When [other]** — adversary/creature/target/demon/ooze/burrower/bear/ogre makes a successful attack, takes damage, marks HP, is defeated; attack roll against you would succeed; ally within close range fails a roll; etc.
- **While** — flying, channeling, in your shell, transformed, in beastform, cloaked, unstoppable, spotlighted, on fire, restrained, poisoned, etc.
- **Once per** — session (6), rest (34), long rest (40). Often combined with "when you X" in the same sentence.
- **After you** — make an action roll, make an attack, make a damage roll that deals 1+ HP, cast a spell or make an attack, etc.

## Part 2: Regex detectability and multi-match report

Candidate regex patterns were run over all 949 texts. For each pattern:

- **Features matching** — number of feature texts that match the pattern at least once.
- **Features matching 2+ times** — number of those texts where the pattern matches **more than once** (same feature, multiple triggers).

### Pattern results

| Pattern ID | Features matching | Features matching 2+ times | Notes |
|------------|-------------------|----------------------------|--------|
| when_you | 140 | 16 | Reliable; some features have 2 "When you" clauses. |
| when_you_short | 154 | 23 | Broader capture; more multi-match (e.g. Wizard Strange Patterns, Ranger's Focus). |
| when_you_would | 8 | 0 | Narrow, clean (e.g. "when you would take Severe damage"). |
| after_you | 14 | 1 | Few matches; Guardian Unstoppable has 2 "After you" clauses. |
| once_per_session | 6 | 0 | Exact phrase; no multi-match. |
| once_per_rest | 76 | 1 | One ability (Book of Homet) has "once per rest" twice. |
| while_ | 31 | 0 | No multi-match in sample. |
| during_ | 5 | 0 | Rest-related; clean. |
| if_you | 18 | 0 | Clean. |
| **on_a_success** | **226** | **33** | **Highest match count; 33 features match 2+ times** (e.g. "On a success... On a result of 4..."). |
| before_you | 19 | 0 | Clean. |
| when_attack_against_you | 9 | 0 | Clean. |
| when_creature | 23 | 1 | Elemental Aura has 2 "when a creature/adversary" clauses. |
| when_you_take_damage | 11 | 0 | Clean. |
| when_you_succeed_attack | 17 | 0 | Clean. |
| when_you_roll | 3 | 0 | Clean. |
| when_ally | 6 | 0 | Clean. |
| at_the_start | 2 | 0 | Clean. |
| at_the_end | 5 | 0 | Clean. |

### Accuracy and multi-trigger takeaways

1. **Reliable for single-trigger detection (0 or 1 multi-match):**  
   `when_you_would`, `once_per_session`, `once_per_rest`, `while_`, `during_`, `if_you`, `before_you`, `when_attack_against_you`, `when_you_take_damage`, `when_you_succeed_attack`, `when_you_roll`, `when_ally`, `at_the_start`, `at_the_end`.

2. **Use with care (multiple matches in same text):**  
   - **on_a_success** — 226 features match, 33 match 2+ times. Many features use "On a success... On a result of N..." or multiple "On a successful attack/roll" clauses. A single regex will often capture only the first or require iteration and disambiguation.
   - **when_you** / **when_you_short** — 16–23 features have 2+ "When you" clauses (e.g. Ranger's Focus, Strange Patterns, Ruthless Predator, Epic Poetry). One regex will match multiple times; you need to decide whether to treat each match as a separate trigger or merge.

3. **Features that trigger the same regex multiple times (examples):**  
   - **Guardian Unstoppable** — two "After you" clauses (damage roll increase; die value would exceed 6).  
   - **Wizard Strange Patterns** — two "When you" (roll that number on Duality Die; take a long rest).  
   - **Wordsmith Epic Poetry** — two "When you" (Help an Ally; "when you do, roll a d10...").  
   - **Wayfinder Ruthless Predator** — two "When you" (make a damage roll; deal severe damage).  
   - **Weapons (Eruptive, Invigorating, Lifestealing)** — two "On a successful attack" / "On a result of N" sentences.  
   - **Warden of the Elements Elemental Aura** — multiple "When an adversary/creature..." clauses.

4. **Recommendation:**  
   - For **frequency** (once per session/rest/long rest), regexes are accurate and rarely multi-match.  
   - For **"When you X"**, use a regex that captures the clause up to ", you can/may" or "." and then **split or iterate** over all matches so features with multiple "When you" triggers are represented correctly.  
   - For **"On a success(ful) ..."**, prefer a pattern that matches the first clause only for "trigger" purposes, or explicitly handle "On a result of N" as a sub-condition so one feature does not count as multiple unrelated triggers.

## Features with multiple distinct triggers (sample)

These features have **more than one** extracted trigger in the same text (101 total). Handling them correctly requires either multiple trigger records per feature or a combined trigger model.

| Source | Feature | Triggers (abbreviated) |
|--------|---------|-------------------------|
| ancestries/Faerie | Luckbender | after_you: ally makes action roll; once_per: session |
| communities/Orderborne | Dedicated | when_you: embodying principles; once_per: rest; once_per_when: embodying principles |
| classes/Druid | Beastform | when_you: drop out... armor slots remain; while: transformed; while: in beastform |
| classes/Guardian | Unstoppable | after_you: damage roll / die increase; while: unstoppable; when_other: die value exceed; once_per: long rest |
| classes/Ranger | Ranger's Focus | when_you: deal damage to them; when_you: fail an attack against them |
| classes/Rogue | Cloaked | after_you: make an attack or end move; while: cloaked...; when_other: adversary moves... |
| classes/Rogue | Sneak Attack | when_you: succeed on attack while cloaked or ally in melee; while: cloaked or ally in melee |
| subclasses/Warden of the Elements | Elemental Incarnation | when_you: deal damage to adversary in melee; when_other: adversary in melee deals damage to you |
| subclasses/Warden of the Elements | Elemental Aura | when_you: ally takes damage beyond melee; while: channeling; when_other: adversary marks HP / deals damage |
| subclasses/Primal Origin | Arcane Charge | when_you: take magic damage; when_you: successful attack that deals magic while charged; while: charged |

The script prints the first 25 of these in full; run `node scripts/analyze-srd-triggers.js` to regenerate the full report and tables.
